UPDATE offboarding_risk_flags
SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = now()
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND asset_id NOT IN (SELECT asset_id FROM v_offboarding_risk)
  AND set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Phase3 - Offboarding Risk Detection', true) IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO offboarding_risk_flags (
    asset_id, employee_id, employee_name, party_type,
    device_type, office_name, qty, date_of_exit, status, detected_at
)
SELECT
    r.asset_id, r.employee_id, r.employee_name, r.party_type,
    r.device_type, r.office_name, r.qty, r.date_of_exit, 'open', now()
FROM v_offboarding_risk r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM offboarding_risk_flags f
    WHERE f.asset_id = r.asset_id AND f.status = 'open'
)
  AND set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Phase3 - Offboarding Risk Detection', true) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    e.employee_name,
    e.flagged,
    t.total_open,
    t.new_today
FROM (
    SELECT employee_name,
           count(*) AS flagged
    FROM offboarding_risk_flags
    WHERE status = 'open'
    GROUP BY employee_name
) e
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS total_open,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at::date = current_date) AS new_today
    FROM offboarding_risk_flags
    WHERE status = 'open'
) t
ORDER BY e.flagged DESC;
